plan.purpose: Choose a practical model, not establish methodological novelty
plan.features: Same 19 noninvasive variables; train-fitted imputation/encoding. LR_linear excludes engineered hinge/sex-body columns; all others share existing basis preprocessor.
plan.roles: Original PSU-separated train1680 validation372 calibration481 threshold529 test1006
plan.selection: Mean validation four-label macro AP across three seeds; lower macro Brier tie break. Choose configuration and overall family before 2024 evaluation.
plan.calibration: One joint-distribution temperature fitted on calibration role using joint NLL; report raw and calibrated metrics
plan.threshold: Per-label weighted F1 on fixed .01:.01:.99 grid, plus any-abnormality sensitivity95, using threshold role only
plan.neural_loss: weighted joint NLL/4 + .2 mean marginal BCE; same loss for all six neural candidates, AdamW lr .003, wd .001 or .01, 12 hidden units except existing 4-per-group grouped structures
plan.neural_initialization: Unaries from train-only four LR(C=.1); pair energy initialized zero; no external teachers or API keys
plan.trees: Four independently trained binary estimators, shared hyperparameter choice; 120 trees RF; 120 boosting iterations HGB
plan.test_use: Previously inspected 2024; exploratory comparison, not independent confirmatory validation
plan.uncertainty: 300 full-frame stratified PSU resamples of test, paired seed-mean metric differences; fixed trained/calibrated models/thresholds, conditional intervals, no selection uncertainty
plan.speed: CPU one thread; interleaved warmed single-person model inference including calibration and marginal aggregation; excludes input preprocessing/loading/HTTP; preprocessing timed separately
plan.adaptation: Phase, sparse state update, coupled relaxation ideas reimplemented for static rows. No biological connectome, physical simulation, temporal health trajectory or original-weight transfer.

bootstrap_design.method: n_h-1 draws with replacement; multiplicity*n_h/(n_h-1); full survey PSUs; no FPC

plan.purpose: Diagnose first transfer failures and choose practical models under matched clean/missing-input conditions
plan.status: Exploratory follow-up designed after v7 results; same reused2024, not independent validation
plan.roles: Same original train1680 validation372 calibration481 threshold529 test1006
plan.data: 19 noninvasive features; fixed train-only preprocessor; two training views (clean + fixed missing20) for EVERY family with half weights
plan.missingness: Each non-age/sex field independently requested missing with p=.2; waist/WHtR removed together; actual missing fraction audited. Artificial MCAR stress, not proof of natural missingness benefit.
plan.environments: clean plus three reproducible missing masks for validation/test; calibration/threshold use clean plus one mask
plan.selection: Mean validation macro AP across clean and mean of three masked environments, equal environment weights, mean across seeds42/43/44; no test selection
plan.trials: Two settings each. Trees/LR same grids as v7. NN weight_decay .001, learning rates .001/.0003; max180 epochs patience30, includes epoch0 baseline
plan.adaptations: Frozen train-only LR anchor; bounded residuals; group-level amplitude/phase/reliability; sparse drive-initialized updates; four-label relaxation rather than feature-channel dynamics
plan.loss: Same joint NLL/4 + .2 marginal BCE for NN; standard objectives for classical estimators
plan.calibration: One temperature using equally weighted clean/masked2023 calibration role; no evaluation labels
plan.primary: calibrated macro AP in clean and masked environments, Brier; descriptive runtime/size
plan.uncertainty: 200 full-frame test-PSU resamples; masks and seeds paired per person; fixed fit/calibration; no repeated masks treated as independent people
plan.stop: Complete prespecified candidates and report failures too; do not continue tuning based on2024

bootstrap_design.method: n_h-1 draws with replacement; multiplicity*n_h/(n_h-1); full survey PSUs; no FPC

current_checkpoint.scope: Existing v5 checkpoint unchanged; four-label F1 thresholds obtained from original threshold role for this comparison only; no API modification
current_checkpoint.latency_scope: Warm CPU one thread; single row model, existing calibration and marginal aggregation; excludes input preprocessing/loading/HTTP/JSON; interleaved order
current_checkpoint.timing_caution: Runtime implementation comparison. Sklearn overhead is not a mathematical complexity advantage for NN. Existing model training objective/selection differs from newly retrained common-loss group_hurdle.

training_diagnosis.scope: v7 seed42 train/validation replay only, fixed learning rate .003
